verdict.rationale: Auth0 Organizations is a first-party feature for modeling multi-tenant B2B apps: it represents business customers in a single tenant, manages their membership, and gives each organization its own branding, connections, and federated login. The My Organization API, pre-built admin components, and self-service SSO/SCIM extend this for customer admins. missing for 10: explicit evidence of invitation flows, independent or hands-on corroboration of the organizations/membership model.
